tldr: Admins export accounts, transactions, trades and categories as one ZIP of CSV files and NDJSON. The files can be imported with the CSV import feature.
goal: Users need a copy of their data that they can load back into Maybe.

story.heading: Family stores each data export as a record
story.body: Each export request creates a FamilyExport record with a status.

story.heading: Background job builds and attaches the ZIP
story.body: The job sets the export to processing, builds the ZIP, attaches it, then marks it completed or failed.

story.heading: Settings adds an export modal and export list
story.body: The profile settings page shows a modal to start an export and the 10 latest exports.

story.heading: Creating an export queues a background job
story.body: The controller creates a FamilyExport, queues FamilyDataExportJob, and redirects to the profile settings.

story.heading: Export records add a status and a file
story.body: Each export stores a status and a family, with the ZIP file attached.

story.heading: Users export their data as a ZIP
story.body: The ZIP holds CSV files for accounts, transactions, trades and categories, plus all.ndjson.

components.summary: Adds an export modal and an export list to profile settings; the list shows 10 exports.
Adds routes and FamilyExportsController to create, list and download exports, for admins only.
Family::DataExporter builds the ZIP in memory; FamilyExport tracks each export's status and file.
FamilyDataExportJob runs the export and sets it to completed or failed.
Adds the family_exports table with a status column and a family reference.

decisions.title: Build the ZIP in memory
decisions.why: The export returns a StringIO, so the job attaches the ZIP without a temporary file.

decisions.title: Run the export in a background job
decisions.why: The controller only creates a record and queues FamilyDataExportJob, so the request returns at once.

decisions.title: Track the export with a status enum
decisions.why: The enum records the four states, so the download action checks completed and an attached file.
